# VIcons

A premium minimalist SVG icon library for React.

Designed for BP Studio and the V ecosystem.

Features

• Premium minimalist design
• 24×24 canvas
• currentColor
• Tree-shakeable
• React-first
• TypeScript
• Pixel-perfect

Installation

pnpm add @veasnawt/vicons

Usage

import { Idea } from "@veasnawt/vicons";
